falsely claiming speech generation. exporting encoded mp4 may depend on browser/runtime capabilities. a deterministic 180 second playable movie is mandatory; encoded export is secondary unless already supported. existing applications may contain mature engines worth adapting instead of replacing. concurrent work means every target file must be re read immediately before rewrite and public contracts record current public apis before changes. 4. separate canonical schema from renderers. 5. use stable ids for scenes, tracks, actors, cameras, and objects. 6. make duration numeric and clamp negative/nan values. 7. derive total duration from scenes when absent. 8. add scene local time evaluation. 9. add absolute timeline time evaluation. 10. add declarative keyframes. 11. add motion presets as sugar over keyframes. 12. add easing utilities shared by 2d/3d. 13. add 2d primitives required for charts/tutorials. 14. add 3d primitives required for cinematic geometry. 15. add particle emitters in both 2d and 3d adapters where practical. 16. add text/typewriter/count up behavior. 17. add actor primitives with reusable ids. 18. add named cameras and camera cuts. 19. add camera motion presets. 20. add scene transition metadata with graceful fallback. 21. add schema validation messages suitable for ai repair loops. 22. add a compiler from structured ai program instructions to canonical movie data. 23. add persona presets rather than duplicating engine logic. 24. add mobile viewport rules and large touch targets. 25. make preview resize with resizeobserver or a proven existing equivalent. 26. ensure timeline scrub works by touch/pointer events. 27. make the showcase data driven, not embedded in renderer code. 28. assert showcase duration is 180 seconds within numeric tolerance. 29. test multiple scene boundaries and object types programmatically. 30. browser test at desktop and mobile viewport sizes. 31. check console errors after route load and after playback/scene seeks. 32. re read every written file and run tab/line length style audits. 33. compare planned vs actual touched files. 34. keep a final remaining work ledger until every required item is evidence backed. 35. document known limitations honestly rather than hiding them. realistic architecture target reuse the strongest existing movie core if repository evidence reveals one. otherwise create apps/shared/movie/ with small modules for model, validation, time/easing, compiler, 2d primitives, 3d primitives, playback controller, and persona presets. integrate candidate apps through thin adapters/imports instead of cloning the shared core. preserve each app’s visual shell and default workflow while exposing the same underlying project vocabulary. verification target node/static syntax checks for all touched js. focused unit like scripts for validation/timeline/compiler. existing tests relevant to each app. browser route loads with console inspection. mobile viewport interaction checks. showcase seek checks at 0s, scene boundaries, midpoint, and near 180s.

keyframes and animation presets captions/narration/audio cue metadata groups and reusable ids timing/duration/easing errors must identify the path and reason so a model can repair its own movie spec. phase d — app integration for every discovered movie capable app: keep route and brand/personality intact map its project format to/from canonical movie data when needed expose ai prompt/spec generation through shared compiler keep existing manual editing controls functional add or preserve mobile first preview/timeline controls avoid duplicated copies of the canonical schema/compiler phase e — 180 second proof movie create one real data file/program that totals exactly 180 seconds and intentionally includes: at least 10 distinct scenes both 2d and 3d scene content at least 3 named patterns transitions and scene cuts a beginning, progression, climax, recap, and credits like ending phase f — verification 1. syntax check every touched js module. 2. run existing focused tests for each integrated app. 3. add focused tests only where behavior lacks evidence. 4. assert canonical movie validation and the 180 second total. 5. assert scene selection/time localization at boundaries. 6. load each relevant app route in the browser. 7. check console errors. 8. check desktop rendering. 9. check a mobile viewport and touch sized controls. 10. load the showcase and seek multiple times across the full duration. 11. re read every touched file. 12. compare original plan vs actual work and close deltas. exact file policy no implementation file is committed to this plan before discovery. once discovery finishes, discovery.md will enumerate exact files. every modified file will be rewritten whole; oversized touched files will be split into smaller modules rather than partially edited. stop gate stop only when the discovered movie surfaces are integrated or explicitly proven non movie, the 180 second showcase is runnable, tests/browser checks provide evidence, and remaining work.md has no required unresolved item.
